notes.title: STAR-WIRED TAKES TO THE STARS!
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006064/1db15b2e21706609e1774e7b45ba4d44256a4eac.png[/img]

We've finished the development of Star-Wired, and released the game right now! After nearly a year since we began development and days of squashing issues in engine, the game is wrapped up neatly and delivered right to your desktop! We hope you enjoy your time helping Bit restore the starship to a complete state.

Please leave a review of your experience!

Sincerely,
Motherbored Games
A DePaul University Capstone Group

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006064/818bd2be2f26c1e00a1bf36ac11b2b04191c4b4d.png[/img]
